name: Agnosphitys
isnote: Wikipedia calls it a dinosauriform; PBDB lists it in Guaibasauridae, which has no atlas entry.
sum: Agnosphitys is a Late Triassic dinosauriform from Britain, known from an ilium and a partial skeleton.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
material: A second specimen is a partial skeleton with a left maxilla, humerus and astragalus.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Fraser et al. 2002

sources.text: N. C. Fraser, K. Padian, and G. M. Walkden, A. L. M. Davis. 2002. Basal dinosauriform remains from Britain and the diagnosis of the Dinosauria. Palaeontology 45(1):79-95
